newsitem.title: UK: Innovative Tech rises on bullish outlook.
newsitem.headline: Innovative Tech rises on bullish outlook.

text.p: Innovative Technologies rose 10 1/2 pence to 242 1/2 on Monday after it announced a confident outlook on the group's current and future performance.
The group said it expected gross revenue for the year to December 1996 to amount to 1.7 million stg which was less than expectations but said it had faced the initial challenges.
The company said it had intalled "significant" capacity to manufacture alginates, films and hydrocolloids, capable of generating 50 million stg per annum, at today's prices.
The company currently has 14 woundcare partnerships and said that present negotiations could double that number by year end.
The company said it would soon place five percent of its issued share capital for cash. The company gave no details. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 4366
